pitch:
SMS Buddy Sale-Ready Pack, for your next sale (smsbuddy.lk).

Your sale announced to your whole customer list by SMS, under your shop's name, in Sinhala, Tamil or English. LKR 560, tax included: 1,000 SMS credits, valid for 6 months.

- Try it first: create a free account and send 10 test SMS to your own phone before you pay anything.
- We set it up for you: WhatsApp us your customer list as an Excel or CSV file. We load it and help you write your first message the same working day.
- Clear Sinhala pricing: a Sinhala or Tamil message up to 70 characters uses 1 credit (English up to 160). The credit count shows before you send.
- Customers can reply: every message can end with your WhatsApp number, and an opt-out line is added to promotions.
- Guarantee: your business name approved within 1 working day, or we add 500 free SMS. Any message the delivery report shows as failed is credited back.

Set up by 10 December to be sending for 12.12. Bigger packages bring the rate down to LKR 0.45 per SMS.
